business: 3D Walkthroughs (working name): turns a builder's 2D plans into a 3D walkthrough, flythrough video and renders before the home is built
target: Owners or sales leads of Utah custom and semi-custom luxury home builders (homes roughly $1M+), who decide how a home is marketed and priced before construction
where: Utah: Wasatch Front, Utah County, Park City, St. George

segments.name: Owner of a small custom builder (2-6 luxury homes a year)
Owner of a mid-size custom builder (7-20 homes a year, Parade regular)
Sales or marketing lead at a larger luxury/semi-custom builder (20+ homes a year)

behaviours.name: Relationship buyer
behaviours.how: Works with the same subs and designers for years; tries someone new only through a referral.

behaviours.name: Already has a plan designer who does renders
behaviours.how: Their architect or plan designer already produces renders in Chief Architect or similar as part of the plans.

behaviours.name: Parade of Homes marketer
behaviours.how: Spends real money each year on Parade entries, photography and staging to win buyers.

behaviours.name: Cost cutter
behaviours.how: Margins are tight with interest rates and lumber; every line item in the bid gets questioned.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Likes new tools, has tried Matterport or VR, asks what else is possible.

behaviours.name: Clients find us by word of mouth
behaviours.how: Has more work than crews; doesn't feel a need to market harder.

objections: My plan designer already gives me renders
My clients would rather put that money into finishes
Will it actually match the plan, or show things we won't build?
AI-made? Will it look cheap next to a $2M house?
What happens every time the client changes the plan?
I can get renders online for less
Does this actually help me sell or close faster?
Who are you, and who else have you done this for?
habits: you meet clients at the design center or on the lot
you entered a home in the Parade of Homes last year
you spend most days driving between job sites
you price homes with a cost-plus or fixed-bid sheet your estimator builds
you get most new clients from referrals and past buyers
